$comment: semtext.dev route parity manifest — the contract the parity harness runs
against (ExUnit layer app/test/parity, Node driver app/scripts/parity/parity-check.mjs,
Cypress layer app/e2e). Every route the Next.js site (landing-preview web/) serves
at manifest-generation time, with the title/h1/key-text expectations the Hologram
GAP semantics: a route the Hologram app does not serve (404) is a GAP — reported,
never a failure. A route the app DOES serve but whose title/h1/key text diverges is
a FAIL (parity regression). Regenerate with gen-manifest.mjs whenever the Next.js
site gains/changes routes — never hand-edit titles or h1s.
Owners are the P0 port lanes: port-landing (landing page + its sections),
generatedFrom: landing-preview web/ branch integration/landing-preview (app/*/page.tsx metadata + static export out/)

nextSite.note: Next.js static export uses trailing-slash URLs; the Hologram app serves extensionless paths. The harness normalizes: /docs/ == /docs.
